title: Blue Planet III is keeping the rough edges in the age of AI
script:
BBC is keeping rough edges in Blue Planet III to prove authenticity.
Previous incarnations of the nature series were defined by gorgeous crystal-clear footage.
Past footage seemed almost too good to be real.
One dead giveaway of AI is when digital video looks overly polished.
Producers are leaving in less-than-perfect shots to counter automated video generation.
Would you trust a nature documentary made entirely by algorithms?
